result.instructions: Tools for Transdirect, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Price a 5 kg carton from Sydney 2000 to Melbourne 3000 and show the cheapest real courier."; "Show me our bookings from this week that are not paid yet."; "Track shipment TD123456 and tell me where it is.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Transdirect data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run transdirect_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run transdirect_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run transdirect_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. transdirect_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: transdirect_get_member
tools.title: Get member account
tools.description: Get the Transdirect member account behind the API key: company, credit limit and available credit, charge type, discount factor. Transdirect API: GET /member.

tools.name: transdirect_list_payment_methods
tools.title: List payment methods
tools.description: List the saved payment methods (credit card or PayPal) on the member account. Use an id as payment_method in transdirect_confirm_booking. Transdirect API: GET /members/payment-methods.

tools.name: transdirect_list_couriers
tools.title: List couriers
tools.description: List the couriers Transdirect supports, grouped by carrier, with the courier ids used in quotes and transdirect_confirm_booking. Transdirect API: GET /couriers.

tools.name: transdirect_search_locations
tools.title: Search suburbs and postcodes
tools.description: Search valid Australian suburbs and postcodes for an address. Use the suburb, state and postcode in quotes. Transdirect API: GET /locations/search.

q.description: Suburb name or postcode to search for.

tools.name: transdirect_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List the member's bookings, optionally since a value Transdirect accepts for `since`. Each booking has status, courier, connote and cost. Transdirect API: GET /bookings.

since.description: Only bookings changed since this value (format per Transdirect).

sort.description: Sort order, as Transdirect accepts it.

tools.name: transdirect_get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking
tools.description: Get one booking: status, is_paid, courier, sender and receiver, items, cost, connote and checks. Transdirect API: GET /bookings/{id}.

tools.name: transdirect_get_label_url
tools.title: Get a label link
tools.description: Get a signed public URL for the booking's shipping label PDF. The link opens the PDF without a login. Transdirect API: GET /bookings/{id}/public_url.

tools.name: transdirect_track_shipment
tools.title: Track a shipment
tools.description: Track a shipment by its reference or connote: state (picked_up, in_transit, delivered, attention, ...), headline and per-item events. Transdirect API: GET /tracking/{reference}.

tools.name: transdirect_get_quotes
tools.title: Get courier quotes
tools.description: Create a DRAFT booking for a shipment and return courier quotes (prices and tiers). Nothing is paid or lodged. Quotes can include a demo courier (sandbox only): never confirm a demo quote for a real shipment. Transdirect API: POST /bookings.

state.description: State code, e.g. NSW, VIC, QLD.

postcode.description: Postcode: 4 digits in Australia, or the destination postcode abroad.

residential.description: true for a residential address, false for a business.

state.description: State code, e.g. NSW, VIC, QLD.

postcode.description: Postcode: 4 digits in Australia, or the destination postcode abroad.

residential.description: true for a residential address, false for a business.

description.description: Package type or contents, e.g. Carton.

weight.description: Weight of one item in kg.

length.description: Length of one item in cm.

width.description: Width of one item in cm.

height.description: Height of one item in cm.

items.description: Packages. Weight in kg, dimensions in cm.

declared_value.description: Declared value of the goods in AUD (transit cover). Default 0.

customer_reference.description: Your own order or consignment reference.

tools.name: transdirect_confirm_booking
tools.title: Confirm and pay for a booking
tools.description: PAYS and lodges a draft booking with the chosen courier. Charges the payment method you pass. Call only after the user approves this courier, tier, price and payment method. Demo is refused. Transdirect API: POST /bookings/{id}/confirm.

courier.description: Courier id from transdirect_get_quotes, e.g. couriers_please.

tier.description: Quote tier number, when the courier offers several.

payment_method.description: Payment: 'credit' (member credit account) or a saved method id nab_<id> / paypal_<id>. Demo is refused.

pickup_date.description: Pickup date yyyy-mm-dd, if the quote asks for one.

confirm.description: Must be true: the user explicitly approved paying for and lodging this booking now.

annotations.title: Confirm and pay for a booking

tools.name: transdirect_cancel_booking
tools.title: Cancel a booking
tools.description: Cancel a booking. Transdirect applies its own refund, courier cancellation or support escalation. Call only after the user approves the cancellation. Transdirect API: POST /bookings/{id}/cancel.

reason.description: Reason for the cancellation (sent to Transdirect).

confirm.description: Must be true: the user explicitly approved cancelling this booking now.
